% A test for tex8web's table of contents with tocloft: each level in the
% font of its \cft<level>font (a part in small capitals, chapters in
% italics, sections in italics, subsections in bold, subsubsections in a
% larger sans serif, paragraphs in typewriter, subparagraphs slanted).
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\usepackage{lipsum}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{5}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
\setlength{\cftsubsecindent}{3.8em}
\setlength{\cftsubsubsecindent}{3.8em}
\setlength{\cftparaindent}{3.8em}
\setlength{\cftparanumwidth}{0em}
\setlength{\cftsubparaindent}{3.8em}
\setlength{\cftsubparanumwidth}{0em}
\renewcommand{\cftpartfont}{\Large\scshape}
\renewcommand{\cftchapfont}{\normalfont\itshape}
\renewcommand{\cftsecfont}{\itshape}
\renewcommand{\cftsubsecfont}{\bfseries}
\renewcommand{\cftsubsubsecfont}{\large\sffamily}
\renewcommand{\cftparafont}{\ttfamily}
\renewcommand{\cftsubparafont}{\slshape}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{First}
Some text.
\section{A section}
\lipsum[1]
\subsection{A subsection}
\lipsum[1]
\subsubsection{A subsubsection}
\lipsum[1]
\paragraph{A paragraph}
\lipsum[1]
\subparagraph{A subparagraph}
\lipsum[1]
\chapter{Second}
\section{Another section}
\lipsum[2]
\end{document}
